scope: Chromium DOM and HTTP fixture behavior; no real auth, database, Harness, indexing service or model provider

checks.name: login renders current assets with CSP and synthetic account
page reload restores cookie login and selected workspace
temporary startup auth failure keeps cookie and retry restores login
document totals, current index states and malicious title are literal
upload opens and cancels without a document POST
content search and clear preserve untrusted text
raw document preview remains literal text
workspace switch disables upload for viewer and restores owner
new session and suggestion fill composer without sending
rejected message POST preserves draft and never retries
SSE completion reconciles durable history and clears accepted input
Markdown answers, inline sources, copy and mobile drawer
renderer keeps HTML and unsafe links literal; unverified citation cannot read a source
source drawer retains inline numbering even when saved source list differs
failed run has a recoverable explanation and preserves its original question
IME does not submit; stop clears draft without resending or inventing a saved answer
session rename and confirmed delete update UI and fixture
suspended approval cannot approve when fixed baseline fails
page reload restores selected session and its pending approval
older history keeps latest suspended run and approval visible
full session page and composer remain reachable on laptop height
mobile documents, search and approval fit viewport
cross-tab logout prevents delayed private text body from restoring DOM
cross-tab logout prevents delayed private json body from restoring DOM
cross-tab logout prevents delayed private 401 body from restoring DOM
401 returns to login and clears private DOM content
logout clears cookie and remains logged out after reload
no JavaScript errors, external requests or unhandled fixture routes
